title: Totals
description: Pricing breakdown provided by the business. MUST contain subtotal and total entries. Detail types (tax, fee, discount, fulfillment) MAY be included. Platforms render entries according to display_order or standard receipt hierarchy.

subtotal.description: Subtotal entry representing total item cost before taxes, shipping, or discounts.

total.description: Final total amount due for the order.

fulfillment.description: Shipping, delivery, or pickup fulfillment cost entry.

tax.description: Total tax entry. May contain itemized sub-line breakdown in lines.

display_order.description: Optional ordering hint specifying exact top-to-bottom display sequence for UI receipt rendering.
